syllabus_extract: Introduction to sonar locator beacon. Basic principle of sonar locator beacon.
specific_objectives: 18.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe the basic theory of operation of surveillance system of an aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of IB diagrams and L & Ds; Instructor supervision on theory comprehension
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft surveillance system?
How does the aircraft communicate its position to ground radar?
What are the two main types of transponders used in aviation?

development.content:
Definition of Sonar Locator Beacon
Role in Aircraft Surveillance System
Basic Theory of Operation
Signal Transmission and Reception
Integration with Transponder System

Frequency Bands and Allocation
Pulse Modulation Principles
Echo Detection Mechanism
System Components Overview
Operational Constraints and Limits

Comparison with Radar Systems
Advantages of Sonar Locator
Limitations in Aviation Context
Future Trends in Surveillance
Safety Implications of Beacon Failure

summary_questions: Explain the basic principle of operation of the sonar locator beacon.
Describe how the beacon integrates with the aircraft surveillance system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between the sonar locator beacon and the I-band transponder discussed in LP 06.

pft_rows.syllabus: Basic principle of operation of I-band Transponder. Frequency used. Interrogation and response format.
